note: An English term with 0 occurrences in a Hebraic-register corpus is the bridge working, not a defect. Judgement is per concept.

concepts.gloss: Lord, Master, as a title of address.
Service, work, and worship as one word.
Walk, the way one goes; practice.
The Messiah, the Christ, the Anointed One.
Intention, the heart directed in worship.
The kingdom of God; the kingdom of heaven.
Family, household, the community of belonging.
Disciple, one who learns by following.
Repentance, understood as turning and returning.
Instruction, teaching; also the five books.
Righteousness expressed as charity and just dealing.
The divine Name. Rendered LORD in most English translations.
